name: Removed
summary: Creepy Large is an indie horror virtual reality experience. Inspired by the gameplay of Gorilla Tag, Creepy Large plunges players into a sprawling underground labyrinth teeming with terrifying monsters and spine-tingling challenges. Test your dexterity and courage as you navigate through the darkness, evade nightmarish creatures, and confront fearsome obstacles. Can you survive the horrors that lurk within?
